description: Rolling 30-day Insurgency Report. Each run (local CLI and Step Functions) starts from the previously published snapshot, adds the day's new articles, deduplicates by URL (an already-processed article is NOT sent to the agent again; its stored strike is reused), drops every strike published more than 30 days before the report date, renumbers ids 1..N and publishes. The 30 days replace the 90-day RECENCY_WINDOW_DAYS everywhere. A day with no new articles publishes the accumulated set (possibly empty; the frontend already shows 'No machine strikes reported. For now.'). If more than 20% of the day's new articles are discarded, the day's new strikes are NOT added, but the accumulated set is still published with the >30-day cleanup applied, so the globe never shows expired strikes. Binary layout v2, schema/, frontend and Rust code do not change.
steps: pipeline/transform.py: set RECENCY_WINDOW_DAYS = 30 and update its comment (rolling 30-day window of accumulated strikes; a strike older than 30 days before the report date is dropped; exactly 30 days old is kept, matching within_window).

pipeline/transform.py: replace the abort semantics. Remove ReportAborted (and every import/use of it). Add a small result type, e.g. a frozen dataclass ReportOutcome(report: InsurgencyReport, accepted: bool, fetched: int, discarded: int, new: int, carried: int, expired: int). 'fetched' = number of new (non-skipped) articles handed to assembly; 'accepted' = fetched == 0 or discarded / fetched <= DISCARD_THRESHOLD; 'new' = strikes added from this batch (0 when not accepted); 'carried' = previous strikes kept; 'expired' = previous strikes dropped by the window.

pipeline/transform.py: add a pure helper (e.g. drop_known(articles, known_urls) -> list[RawArticle]) that removes (a) articles whose url is already in known_urls UNLESS extract.needs_agent(article) is False (a fully curated row is rebuilt from the curated data at zero agent cost, so curated edits stay authoritative per 'curated overrides > agent'), and (b) duplicate urls within the batch (first occurrence wins). Log a count line like '[transform] reused N already-processed article(s)'. It must run BEFORE any extraction so no agent call is made for a known URL.

pipeline/transform.py: rewrite assemble as assemble(results, report_date, previous: InsurgencyReport | None = None, max_age_days: int | None = RECENCY_WINDOW_DAYS) -> ReportOutcome. Algorithm: compute fetched/discarded/accepted from results (None dossier = discarded); fresh = kept pairs if accepted else []; carried = [s for s in previous.strikes if within_window(s.published, report_date, max_age_days) and s.url not in {a.url for a, _ in fresh}] preserving previous order; expired = previous strikes failing the window. Final order: carried first, then fresh. Renumber: carried strikes get dataclasses.replace(strike, id=i) keeping their stored lat/lon/origin and dossier untouched; fresh strikes go through build_strike(article, dossier, i, geo) with their final id. Never raise for zero articles. Log discards, rejected batches ('[transform] batch rejected: D/F discarded exceeds 20%; publishing the accumulated report without the new strikes'), and expirations.

pipeline/transform.py: update build_report(articles, extractor, report_date=None, max_age_days=RECENCY_WINDOW_DAYS, previous=None) -> ReportOutcome: filter_recent, then drop_known(previous urls), then extract each (NotAnIncident skipped, other exceptions discarded, no retries, as today), then assemble(..., previous, max_age_days). Update run(...) to accept previous: InsurgencyReport | None = None and return ReportOutcome (preflight still runs first, before any fetch). Keep fetch_articles' signature but allow an optional known_urls argument (default None) that applies drop_known, for the Fetch stage.

pipeline/transform.py: add load_snapshot_json(text_or_bytes) / read_previous(out_dir) helpers as needed: the local previous snapshot is out_dir/snapshot.json; missing file -> None; an unreadable or invalid file must NOT be silently replaced (raise a dedicated error, e.g. PreviousSnapshotInvalid(ValueError)), so accumulated data is never lost.

pipeline/cli.py: the local CLI accumulates too. Read the previous snapshot from --out (snapshot.json) unless a new --fresh flag is given (fresh = ignore the existing snapshot; used to regenerate the committed demo fixtures reproducibly). Pass previous to run(). Always write the artifacts of outcome.report (accepted or not). Exit 0 when accepted; exit 3 (keep EXIT_REPORT_ABORTED value 3 but rename it EXIT_BATCH_REJECTED, or keep both names) when the batch was rejected, after writing the cleaned accumulated report; print new/carried/expired/discarded counts. An invalid previous snapshot -> print an error to stderr, write nothing, exit 4 (EXIT_PREVIOUS_INVALID). --max-age-days default becomes 30 (help text: drop strikes published more than N days before the report date; 0 disables). Update the module docstring.

pipeline/stages.py: add Storage.get_optional(key) -> bytes | None (S3Storage: catch the lazy-imported botocore ClientError via getattr(exc, 'response') with Error.Code in {'NoSuchKey', '404'} -> None, re-raise anything else; InMemoryStorage: missing key -> None). Add a helper _load_latest(storage) that reads snapshots/latest/snapshot.json via get_optional and parses it with InsurgencyReport.from_json (None if missing; invalid content raises).

pipeline/stages.py fetch: load the latest snapshot and pass its strike URLs as known_urls to the fetcher (transform.fetch_articles(report_date, offline=..., per_feed_limit=..., known_urls=...)), so already-processed articles are never staged nor sent to the agent. Return the same shape as today (items may be empty).

pipeline/stages.py assemble: load the latest snapshot as previous, call transform.assemble(pairs, report_date, previous=previous), and ALWAYS publish outcome.report to snapshots/{date}/snapshot.{json,bin} and snapshots/latest/snapshot.{json,bin} (same content types and CACHE_CONTROL). Timeline row: status 'published' when accepted, 'rejected' when the batch was rejected; fields pk, date, status, total, by_severity, new, carried, expired, fetched, discarded, skipped, generated_at. Keep the conditional-put guard but for status 'rejected' (a rejected rerun never replaces a day already recorded as 'published'): update DynamoTimeline.record, _keeps_published_row and InMemoryTimeline accordingly. Return {published: True, accepted, report_date, total, by_severity, new, carried, expired, fetched, discarded, skipped}. Update the module docstring.

infra/statemachine/rebellion.asl.json: rename PublishedChoice to AcceptedChoice (Variable $.accepted, BooleanEquals false -> a Fail state BatchRejectedFail with Error 'BatchRejected' and a Cause explaining that more than 20% of the day's articles were discarded, the new strikes were not added, and the cleaned accumulated report was still published), Default -> Done (Succeed). Update the top-level Comment and the Assemble Comment to describe accumulation.

infra/template.yaml (IAM only in this feature): FetchFunction and AssembleFunction also need s3:GetObject on ${SnapshotBucket.Arn}/snapshots/latest/* and s3:ListBucket on ${SnapshotBucket.Arn} with Condition StringLike s3:prefix 'snapshots/latest/*' (without ListBucket S3 returns AccessDenied instead of NoSuchKey for the first run). Update the Description text to say the report accumulates a rolling 30-day window. Do not touch CodeUri or CloudFront here (FEAT-003).

Tests, pipeline/tests/test_pipeline.py: update for RECENCY_WINDOW_DAYS == 30 (test_default_window_is_thirty_days; within_window bounds around 2026-10-15/2026-10-14 for 30); offline report has 5 strikes with ids 1..5, no SolarWinds, no Fridges; move the Fridges/BBC curated-precedence test to a report that still includes it (e.g. max_age_days=0 or a report date within 30 days of 2026-10-12); replace every ReportAborted/abort test with ReportOutcome assertions. Add tests: (1) accumulation keeps a previous strike within 30 days and drops one published 31 days before the report date while keeping one exactly 30 days old; (2) an article whose URL is in the previous snapshot is NOT sent to the agent (counting stub stays at 0 calls) and its stored dossier/coords are reused with a renumbered id; (3) duplicate URLs inside one batch call the agent once; (4) a fully curated row whose URL is already stored is rebuilt from curated data (edited override wins) without an agent call; (5) zero new articles publishes the accumulated set (accepted) and an empty previous gives an empty report; (6) >20% discarded -> accepted False, new strikes absent, expired strikes removed, carried kept; (7) CLI: accumulates from --out, --fresh ignores it, exit 3 writes the cleaned report, invalid previous snapshot -> exit 4 and the file is left untouched, exit 2 on AgentUnavailable still reads no feed.

Tests, pipeline/tests/test_stages.py: seed InMemoryStorage with a snapshots/latest/snapshot.json and cover: fetch excludes known URLs from staging; assemble merges carried + new, renumbers ids and keeps snapshot.json/snapshot.bin ids consistent (decode the .bin with binary.decode); assemble with zero results publishes the accumulated set; rejected batch publishes the cleaned set and records status 'rejected'; a rejected rerun never replaces a 'published' Timeline row (InMemoryTimeline and DynamoTimeline conditional put); S3Storage.get_optional returns None on NoSuchKey and re-raises other errors (stub client). Remove tests asserting the old abort-without-publish behavior.

Tests, pipeline/tests/test_statemachine.py: assert the AcceptedChoice/BatchRejectedFail flow and the new IAM statements for Fetch and Assemble (GetObject on snapshots/latest/*, ListBucket with the prefix condition).

Expect 5 strikes. Verify md5sum of the three .bin files match and the two .json files are identical. test_offline_run_reproduces_the_committed_snapshot must pass. rebellion-core/tests/decode_test.rs asserts no strike count (only non-empty and date 2026-11-14), so no Rust change is needed; cargo test cannot run locally (note as unverified).
Run ruff and black on pipeline/ and fix any issues.

findings: Implemented as specified; not committed (orchestrator instruction). Decisions: assemble orders carried strikes first, then fresh ones; a fresh strike with the same URL as a carried one replaces it. drop_known also dedupes URLs within a batch when known_urls is None (fetch_articles always applies it). Fully curated rows already stored are rebuilt (not carried), so an offline rerun on its own snapshot is byte-identical (test_offline_rerun_on_its_own_report_is_idempotent). load_snapshot_json rejects non-dict JSON, version != 2, and missing/invalid fields with PreviousSnapshotInvalid(ValueError); stages._load_latest lets it propagate so the Lambda fails without overwriting. CLI reads --out/snapshot.json before preflight, so an invalid previous snapshot exits 4 even when the agent is unavailable. CLI exit constants: EXIT_AGENT_UNAVAILABLE=2, EXIT_BATCH_REJECTED=3 (EXIT_REPORT_ABORTED removed), EXIT_PREVIOUS_INVALID=4. stages.fetch passes known_urls as a frozenset (frozenset() when no latest report). Timeline rows carry new/carried/expired/fetched/discarded/skipped. handler.py unchanged (no renamed exports). Docs/steering still describe ReportAborted/PublishedChoice/90 days: FEAT-004 must update .kiro/steering/agent-enrichment.md, .kiro/specs/attack-globe/design.md, README.md, AGENTS.md, and the regen hooks (add --fresh to the regen command).
